title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Professor Alexander Chen is the Founding Director of the LGBTQ+ Advocacy Clinic at Harvard Law School, where he also teaches Gender Identity, Sexual Orientation, and the Law. He is one of the nation’s leading experts in LGBTQ+ civil rights law. Prof. Chen’s work has been featured in the New York Times, the Economist, the Guardian, […]
